start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:choose-which-ai-answers-me with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and agent_id \"agent:sample-writer\"."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the one choice is kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps one value, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:choose-which-ai-answers-me" with store and the agent_id the person chose, or "" for automatic routing. Ask the person first.
3. The first run makes the store's own object once and proves the choice on the example steps; every step must give its outcome, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps the new choice and reads it back.

worked_examples.title: Choose an AI to answer me
worked_examples.ask: Let agent:sample-writer answer me from now on.
